name: anshi-mvp-route-candidates
reviewDecision: Both illustrative RoutePlans and all three RouteSegments are approved within the stated low-certainty usage boundary.
coordinateReferenceSystem: OGC:CRS84 (WGS84 longitude, latitude); no reprojection performed

routePlans.routeName: 燕军向潼关方向推进（示意）

excludedNodes.reason: The reviewed evidence supports Luoyang, Shanzhou and Tongguan as the macro sequence for this route, but does not establish Lingbao as a Yan westward route node before Tongguan.
The reviewed evidence records an intended eastward advance but does not establish that the Tang force reached Shanzhou before the Lingbao defeat.
The reviewed evidence records an intended eastward advance but does not establish that the Tang force reached Luoyang before the Lingbao defeat.

routePlans.excludedMovement: The post-battle retreat or rout is not part of this ADVANCE RoutePlan.

processing: Use only already approved modern representative point coordinates for the reviewed macro nodes of each RoutePlan.
Create one two-position LineString for each adjacent reviewed node pair; do not add intermediate vertices.
Do not query or follow modern roads, railways, river crossings, mountain passes, shortest paths or routing services.
Treat each line as a LOW-certainty explanatory connector between modern narrative anchors, not as a historical route reconstruction.
usageBoundary: Curated review evidence. Both RoutePlans and all three RouteSegments are approved. Every straight connector must be visibly labelled as illustrative. The lines do not establish Tang-period roads, exact city, pass or battlefield positions, marching tracks, crossings, retreat routes, distances, speeds, widths or occupied areas. No route feature may enter release data until all remaining MVP-03 field-level dependencies receive human approval.
